test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which plateau, with an average elevation of about 600 meters (2000 feet), is bounded by three mountain ranges: the Satpura range to the north and the Eastern and Western Ghats on either side?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deccan Plateau**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The large **Deccan Plateau **in **southern India **is located **between **the **Western Ghats **and the **Eastern Ghats**.
 
• It is **loosely defined **as the **peninsular region **between **these ranges **that is **south **of the **Narmada river**. 
 
• To **the north**, it is **bounded by **the **Satpura **and **Vindhya Ranges**.
 
• **The plateau **is **drier than **the **coastal region **of **India**.
 
• **It ranges between 100 and 1,000 meters **(330 and 3,280 ft), with an average **elevation **of about **600 meters (2,000 ft).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Marwar **(also called the Jodhpur region) is a region of **southwestern Rajasthan **state in **North Western India**. It lies **partly **in the **Thar Desert**.
 
• **The Meghalaya plateau **is traditionally **divided **into **Garo**, **Khasi **and **Jaintia Hills**. The region from the river **Dhansiri **in the east to the **Singimari River. **
 
• The **Chota Nagpur Plateau **is a plateau in **eastern India**, which **covers **much of **Jharkhand state **as well as **adjacent parts of Bihar, Odisha, West Bengal, and Chhattisgarh**.
